lead.headline: Rice still hasn't been seen practising — Jacobs may not be activated
lead.deck: The Jets D/ST went in free this morning; two coin flips wait on Friday's reports.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice has no practice on record since his Week 4 hamstring and knee; Kansas City said on 16 Oct they expect him back, but ESPN's QUESTIONABLE has nothing behind it yet. Josh Jacobs practises from today, but his roster exemption runs to 26 Oct, so Green Bay can leave him out on Sunday without a roster move. The owner added the Jets D/ST for the Patriots this morning — free, no priority spent — at home to an 0-5 Miami. The lineup projects 122.0 against Furia Regia's 111.6, 55% on ESPN; the projection would take Rice over Pickens by 0.2 and Jacobs over Gordon by 0.9, both coin flips that wait for Thursday and Friday.
